design.name: 旱魃
design.brief: Chapter boss Ba the drought goddess (旱魃), who 'wears green clothes' in the Shan Hai Jing: a towering, gaunt, unsettlingly graceful goddess with very long limbs, ash-grey sun-cracked skin, long white hair floating upward in the heat, a calm terrifying face with eyes of blazing white-gold sun fire. Tattered layered robes of faded jade-green and teal (青衣) with old gold Dunhuang borders, cracked jade ornaments, a huge burning sun ring (日轮) floating behind her back, a glowing sun core in her chest (weak spot). Bare feet with five toes standing on cracked dry earth that splits around her. Long hands with a clearly separate thumb and four long fingers.
design.weapon: no weapon; one hand raised calling down the sun
